keyboard_diagnosis.classification: Harness event-construction defect / invalid native Enter acceptance evidence; do not classify 48 assertions as 48 product defects and do not turn them into passes.
keyboard_diagnosis.source_observation: Exact frozen harness key() emits text only for Space, not Enter. Native HelpDetails has no custom keyboard handler. Standard Puppeteer Enter mapping includes text="\r". The observed three-failure pattern per helper is consistent with Enter not generating character activation, then Space toggling the opposite expected state.

limits: This is an observed computed-description association regression in the frozen browser run, not an absent DOM ID or empty DOM text, and not caused by missing Enter text.
Trace retains result_keys only for AX responses, so full AX names/description sources and exact node bodies cannot be reconstructed offline.
